summary: Filter coursework and rubrics by gym with All gyms, show estimated duration and missing-deadline flags, and require explicit planning fields for actual coursework across UI/REST/MCP.
rationale: The user explicitly requires deadlines and estimates. Validation now rejects missing or invalid coursework dates and implicit estimates, while preserving legacy reads and allowing deadline-free optional self-study. Existing synthetic fixtures now supply explicit planning inputs; teaching-lab imports correctly declare self-study. Shared rubrics remain labeled and available within a selected gym.
authorization: User browser comment: separation of coursework and rubrics by gyms with an option of all; deadline should be required and existing coursework should have one; estimated time is required too. D-014 records this explicit authorization, preserving source truth and scheduling authority.
validation: 157 backend tests passed, including missing/null/invalid/timezone-naive deadlines, invalid/missing estimates, partial revisions, MCP authoring and self-study isolation. Frontend build and authoring browser journey passed, including two-gym/shared-rubric filtering, All gyms, prefilled editable deadline and disabled saves for missing planning fields. Live browser filtering verified; default API restarted with validation. Architecture and skill validation passed; committed-diff coverage checked against 9132a64. Historical deadline backfill remains pending missing source information/learner clarification; no dates fabricated.
rollback: Revert this commit and rebuild/restart the default server. Retain all coursework, dates, estimates, source records and grades; no destructive data migration is introduced. Older clients must supply explicit planning inputs while the new validation is active.
